snippet.title: Relocation for work in tech - why? how?
snippet.description:
Moving for work is a challenge, but it's worth it - I share my experience and perspective on relocation as someone who relocated with Amazon to UK from Europe. If you thinking about relocation or are just curious - this vid is for you.

Bonus tips:
- Interested in working @ Cisco? Send your resume over and I can forward it for you: rswidzin@cisco.com
- If you ever give your number to recruiters from outsourcing company - get a second sim card, otherwise they will never stop calling you. You can also ask to delete your number from their database if you didn't do it.
- Relocation can be easier if you move with friend/partner. Ask around who is interested!
- Share this video with a friend who is thinking about relocation
- If you work in bigger company - you also can relocate within the company, usually there are policies and programs in place to improve employee retention.
